reviewed_by: Claude curator acting under owner authority
summary: Second, substantially different sketch run end to end: neutral spec v0.1 -> Revit concept model -> three designer reviews -> corrected spec v0.2. Nine divergences between v0.1 and design intent, all in topology, form, composition, host binding or evidence class; none in the dimensioned numbers.
rationale: The loop is reproducible from the files (sketch, v0.1, v0.2) and answers the open question from CUR-2026-10-27-BUILDING-001-SKETCH-REVIEW: the sketch-reconstruction discipline was tested on a substantially different sketch. It supports the proposal's evidence classes but exposes two gaps that the proposal does not cover: (1) no class for AI estimates the designer accepted, and (2) a literal conflict between the proposal's 'user clarification resolves contradictions' and v0.12's owner_statement confidence cap and geometric authority hierarchy. Both are routed to a new proposal (evidence-class-mapping) rather than a protocol change, because they are normative and need owner decision. The richer handoff format is kept as a draft integration schema, not canonical. Production-side (Revit) lessons were filed with ARPL (gschmidtke/ARPL PR #1) per stratum ownership.
provenance: Revit 2024 concept model generated via the Revit API, reviewed by the designer on 2026-10-26
Designer corrections in session: upper box 10 x 7 m confirmed; glazing 1.5 m; stair 1 m wide, +x, max 8 risers per flight; upper roof flat; lower box no overhang; railing and facade frame accepted
